6kMotion spec — storyboard
Motionstoryboard · timings · reduce-motion fallbackDEFAULT EASE cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1) · UI TRANSITIONS ≤ 450MS · DECORATIVE INK / PAPER ≤ 700MS
Card grows into the profile — “page turn”
0 · TAP
→
140 · LIFT
→
360 · PAGE
360ms · default ease
The row’s polaroid and name are shared elements. The card scales up with a slight rotateY hinge on the left edge; everything else fades out in the first 120ms and the page body fades in over the last 160ms.
Ink underline on save
Saved
0
→
Saved
350
→
Saved
700
700ms · cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1)
scaleX 0 → 1 from the left edge, like a pen stroke. Fires once per save, never on autosave.
Sticky note — stick, then peel
0 · DROP
→
280 · STUCK
→
DELETE · 160
→
340 · GONE
280ms in · 340ms out · spring 300 / 18 · ease-in
Adding: drops from −10° at 108% and settles at its random tilt (±3°) with one small overshoot. Deleting: the bottom-right corner lifts first (rotate +6°, shadow grows), then the note slides up 24px and fades.
Polaroid drop on upload
0
→
300 · OVERSHOOT
→
420 · REST
420ms · cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1)
Falls 24px from −12°, overshoots past its final tilt, then settles. The shadow shrinks as it lands, so it reads as paper meeting the page.
“How do I know…?” — pen stroke
0
→
400 · HOP 1
→
met at…
880 · HOP 2
400ms per hop · 80ms pause · ease-in-out
Hops are added to the Reagraph selection one at a time, so each ink line appears in order. The label fades in at 60% of its hop. The camera eases to fit the whole path over 600ms before the first hop.
Space tab slide
0
→
120
→
240
240ms · ease-out
The active tab rises 4px and fills with color; the divider line under the tabs slides to it. The list below crossfades in 160ms and doesn’t slide.
Page tear on delete
0
→
180 · RIP
→
380 · UNDO
380ms + 220ms · ease-in · default
A jagged clip-path runs across the page, which tilts 5° and drops 40px while fading. The list closes the gap in 220ms and the undo toast slides up 12px. Undo plays it backwards.
Reduce motion — everything above
A
→
75
→
150 · B
150ms · linear opacity
No transforms, springs or tilt changes. The pen path and ink underline appear fully drawn, and toasts appear in place. It turns on from Settings → Appearance or the device’s prefers-reduced-motion setting.

Try next: "animate the motion storyboard for real" · "dark mode for the graph" · "the password reset email"

Reagraph mapping
Canvastheme.canvas.background #F6F1E7; paper grain is a CSS overlay with pointer-events:none
Nodefill = first space's tab color. icon = a canvas texture: photo or initials, 3px #FFFCF6 rim, 1.5px space-color hairline
LabelsInstrument Sans via labelFontUrl, 11.5px, label.stroke #F6F1E7. Small nodes: labelType="auto"
ClustersclusterAttribute="primarySpace"; dashed stroke in the tab color @ 55%, fill @ 5%
Edges#221F1A @ 34%, size 1, edgeArrowPosition="none"; former → dashed
Edge labelsrelationship type, 10.5px, edgeLabelPosition="above"
Path / selectselections + actives; #253C6B size 3; everything else inactiveOpacity .2
Big notebookscollapsedNodeIds per space; the bubble is a custom renderNode
Family treelayoutOverrides.getNodePosition: one row per generation, partners side by side

AI is off
Quick capture needs an AI key of your own.
Add a Gemini or OpenAI-compatible key in Settings. Your text goes from your FolkBook server to the provider you pick, and nowhere else. Local models work too.
Google Gemini OpenAI OpenRouter Ollama · LM Studio
Everything else in FolkBook works without it — AI only ever suggests, you always confirm.
